title: Compute Shader Ray Tracing in WebGPU with Rust and WGSL
description: Build a WebGPU compute shader ray tracer in Rust and WGSL. Trace spheres and planes, cast hard shadows, add two reflection steps, and present a storage texture.
imageAlt: Three glossy spheres reflected across red, green, white, and black walls in a WebGPU compute ray traced room.
